evidence_gate.meaning: Record completeness only; populated entries still require review and physical verification.

limitations: The 400 ns allocation is inherited, conditional and unqualified; it is not an actuator stop deadline.
Only continuous monotone ramps after sufficient differential overdrive are screened; steps, noise, bouncing rails and pulses remain unqualified.
The ACT-09 UV boundary is 3.005 V; the ACT-07 OV boundary remains 3.6 V. Neither is an observed hardware failure threshold.
HiZ, pulldown and TVS topology do not establish receiver input-low voltage, pulse rejection or actuator stop response.
Receiver identity, thresholds, feed/capacitance, pulse policy, missing-signal response, readiness, stop deadline and harness evidence remain required.
Missing qualifications default disabled. Local VSERVO does not establish remote receiver readiness.
Timing arithmetic and record completeness cannot approve hardware, fabrication or use.

scenarios.title: Local 3.3 V monotone fault ramp
scenarios.trigger: Upstream rail reaches the inherited allocated overdrive point with all stated model conditions valid.
scenarios.required: Complete the entire downstream inhibit path before the relevant supply-valid boundary. Retain the fault and clear READY.
scenarios.observe: Upstream rail, sense input, detector, QUAL, U12 READY, OE, U4 output and both connector signals on a shared timebase.
scenarios.unknown: Actual ramp-delay applicability, physical isolation endpoint and receiver voltage/pulse acceptance.
scenarios.cannot_infer: Positive arithmetic headroom is not a measured connector-low or stop time.

scenarios.title: Step, short excursion or fault during PWM high
scenarios.trigger: A non-monotone fault or interruption at any phase of an existing command pulse.
scenarios.required: Bound detection/retention and the full output waveform, including the truncated pulse and any later edge. Declare excluded waveform classes explicitly.
scenarios.observe: Fault waveform and duration, original rising edge, all later edges, amplitude at receiver ground and receiver response when separately qualified.
scenarios.unknown: Minimum capturable fault, incomplete-pulse interpretation, amplitude/width/history rejection limits.
scenarios.cannot_infer: A 400 ns path allocation is not a receiver pulse-rejection specification; the preceding high interval also matters.

scenarios.title: Long partial-power dwell or external backfeed
scenarios.trigger: Local logic loses valid power; a receiver, opposite rail or signal remains powered.
scenarios.required: Maintain a defined disabled interface for every permitted dwell and source combination; no gap after stored island energy expires.
scenarios.observe: All rails, OE, connector voltages relative to local and remote grounds, current in each permitted feed path.
scenarios.unknown: Total leakage/feed, effective capacitance, ground offset, partial-power isolation and allowed transient energy.
scenarios.cannot_infer: High impedance does not guarantee low voltage. The 100 us handover allocation does not permit an undefined output interval.

scenarios.title: Supply bounce, stale READY or held acknowledgement
scenarios.trigger: Supply returns after a fault, including a translator-only interruption while the latch stayed powered.
scenarios.required: Keep outputs disabled; confirm fault clear, valid supplies and receiver readiness; restart the healthy interval after bounce; require a fresh ACK with ARM low before later ARM.
scenarios.observe: QUAL at latch clear, READY, conditioned ACK, ARM and both output signals through the complete recovery.
scenarios.unknown: Physical clear width, recovery/setup/hold guards, observation sources and output inhibition during startup.
scenarios.cannot_infer: A timer, completed discharge or restored rail cannot grant permission. Normal disarm retaining READY is distinct from a fault.

scenarios.title: Receiver supply, readiness or ground missing
scenarios.trigger: Remote power/ground/harness disappears or a readiness source is missing, stale or stuck.
scenarios.required: Missing qualification disables; specify the exact supported fault envelope and how a fault is detected. Any uncontained short or ground-loss case blocks that claimed envelope.
scenarios.observe: Actual receiver control supply and ground, readiness interface, local rails and signal injection currents.
scenarios.unknown: Exact receiver identity, readiness behavior, broken-ground current paths, stuck-high fault coverage and signal-loss response.
scenarios.cannot_infer: Local VSERVO or BEC voltage is not independent proof of ESC readiness, especially in ONBOARD.
